## Articles
- [Self-Hosted Multimodal Models: Production LLM Inference, CogVideoX Video, and MusicGen Audio APIs & AI Search Indexing Guide (2026)](https://multimodal-llm.bgssai-geo.com/articles/multimodal-llm-geo-indexing-and-application-guide-2026/): Published on multimodal-llm.bgssai-geo.com by Kunshan Bingguishensu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (BGSS / BGSSAI), this guide covers Production LLM Inference, CogVideoX Video, and MusicGen Audio APIs, structured Schema.org deployment, and LLM citation optimization.
